principle: The level belongs to the cross-form-factor difference. routeLevel is the highest level required by that route, not a license to make every module independent.

L1.meaning: Same product and expression; only geometry, density and typography adapt.
L1.jsonization: Surface modules and interaction semantics stay shared in JSON. Circle/Pill/Rect use token and geometry overrides only. Generic base interactions such as a slider may remain shared.

L2.meaning: Product, data and actions remain shared while selected local expressions differ by form factor.
L2.jsonization: Keep one shared JSON product model, then use module-level variant tokens/visibility/composition metadata for local expression changes. Do not fork the whole page.

L3.meaning: A genuinely different product or interaction surface is required for at least one form factor.
L3.jsonization: JSON still owns content, actions, tokens and engine selection, but a form factor may select a distinct generic experience engine or composition such as honeycomb, paged list or watchface. Engines must remain product-agnostic.

pages/clock.reason: Watchface is a gesture-led independent surface and its composition differs materially by form factor.

pages/clock_guard.reason: Navigation guard has no form-factor-specific product expression.

pages/heartrate.reason: Same health hierarchy and interaction; geometry/density adapt.

pages/steps.reason: Same activity cards and progress semantics; geometry/density adapt.

pages/applist.reason: Circle honeycomb, Pill paged list and Rect designed grid are genuinely different interaction surfaces.

pages/notification_demo.reason: Notification product flow is shared; form factors change only presentation geometry.

pages/history.reason: Shared history data and hierarchy with local chart/card expression differences.

pages/workout_select.reason: Shared workout catalogue and actions; layout dimensions adapt.

pages/workout.reason: Shared live-session semantics with local metric/action composition differences.

pages/workout_history.reason: Shared record list expression with geometric adaptation only.

pages/watchface.reason: Visual selector and preview composition require independent shape-aware surface treatment.

pages/settings/settings.reason: Shared settings information architecture; geometry adapts.

pages/settings/vibration.reason: Shared setting controls and semantics; geometry adapts.

pages/settings/brightness.reason: The direct brightness slider is the same expression on all shapes; only its geometry adapts.

pages/settings/diagnostics.reason: Shared diagnostics content and status semantics; geometry adapts.

pages/settings/motion.reason: Shared sensor controls and measurements; geometry adapts.

pages/today.reason: Shared daily data with local summary/calendar expression changes.
